judge.description: A low camera looks down a long straight obstacle run of glossy coloured tiles that mirror the obstacles (screen-space reflections), past a striped inflatable hammer in sharp focus on the right, clear-coated pads and an inflatable arch, ice blocks, a furry plush ball, glowing neon tube arches, a liquid strip beside the run and particles in the air, to a row of tall pillars with light shafts between them and big distant shapes fading into haze. The far run is softly out of focus (depth of field) and the colours are graded. Expected: simple procedural shapes and no characters; score the mood, gloss, depth haze and grading. Target ref-4: a neon night world, a dark violet sky, magenta and cyan glowing tubes with strong bloom reflected in the dark glossy floor, sparkles and violet night haze.

seen: The frame has the right neon mood: magenta and cyan glowing arches with bloom, a glossy reflective checkered floor, sparkles and violet haze. It is missing most of the described content: no striped hammer, inflatable arch, ice blocks, liquid strip or tall pillars with light shafts, and the sphere reads as a plain matte ball rather than fur. It is also far sparser and cruder than reference-1.
